sampling: Three unchanged suites, separate time/allocation modes, five predeclared three-source blocks; 4096 timing inputs or 1000 allocation inputs per phase. Eighteen preflights precede 90 measurements after all builds finish. No samples are added to any earlier experiment.
qualification: Each variant passes eight shared storage controls, six inherited cache-frontier tests, eleven admitted P4 tests, 882 all-feature scalar library tests, 795 default scalar library tests and 28 doctests. Formatting, strict default/all-feature/all-target Clippy and warning-denied scalar docs pass. Counts overlap; these are not unique or full-workflow totals.
limits: The three pairwise contrasts reuse the same closed sample set; they are not independent additional measurements. Candidate results must be considered against both controls.
Ratios, directions and ranges are descriptive; they establish neither statistical significance nor an application speedup. Every adverse row is retained.
Requested Rust heap counters exclude native C heaps, allocator bookkeeping and stack frames. Equal private type sizes do not establish equal total memory or eventual reclamation.

The union feature can affect other native dependency consumers. Native feature bindings, native qualification/cost controls, full reports, production CLI size, original full-fixture limits and the complete workflow matrix remain open.
